g.text: The Authoritative Single Source of Truth for Architecture, Git Branching, Code Reviews, and Verification
PHASE 1: TASK SPECIFICATION & DEFINITION OF READY (DoR)
• Subsystem defect or UI enhancement request
• Categorized with type: and sub: labels
• Test approach understood before touching code
• 100% pass on statutory unit test cases
• Replays commits cleanly on top of main
PHASE 4: PULL REQUEST, CI AUTOMATION & PEER CODE REVIEW
• Focus on legal accuracy & math precision
• Verify no secret leaks or unpinned deps
PHASE 5: SQUASH MERGE, TRUNK INTEGRATION & CLEANUP
• At least 1 Lead approval (M3 or M6)
• Condenses all branch commits into one
• Clean atomic commit linked to issue:
Optimized GitHub Flow: main is continuously deployable & protected
Violations block pull request approvals and trunk merges
NEVER push directly to main. All changes enter via reviewed PRs.
NEVER commit secrets or .env. Strictly use .env.example.
100% OFFLINE execution. Zero external cloud API dependencies in core flow.
ZERO LLM hallucination in rules. 100% deterministic state machines.
